content: The Ministry of Health in Serbia, along with various experts and representatives from the World Health Organization (WHO) and other global organizations, contributed to this initiative. WHO and UNICEF express their gratitude for the financial support provided by the following organizations: the Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT), the Netherlands Directorate-General for International Cooperation (DGIS), the General Electric (GE) Foundation, the Global Environment Facility/United Nations Development Programme, the Conrad N. Hilton Foundation, the New Venture Fund, the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (Sida), the United Kingdom Department for International Development (DFID), and the United States Agency for International Development (USAID). For detailed information on the global status of water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) in healthcare facilities, refer to the companion document published by the WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme for Water Supply, Sanitation, and Hygiene. This document is available at the WHO website under the water, sanitation, and health section. The guiding principle remains: First, do no harm.
